import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings
import logging

# Suppress all warnings and logs to avoid clutter
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
logging.getLogger("lightgbm").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Define feature columns (exclude id and target)
target_col = "target"
id_col = "id"
cat_col = "f_27"
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in [id_col, target_col]]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df[target_col]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()


# Create a mapping from categories to integers, handling unseen values
def safe_encode(X, training_categories):
    """Encode categorical values, handling unseen categories gracefully."""
    X_encoded = X.copy()
    # Create a set of known categories from training data
    known_categories = set(training_categories)

    # Create a mapping for known categories
    known_mapping = {cat: i for i, cat in enumerate(sorted(known_categories))}

    # For unseen categories, use 0 or a special index
    X_encoded[cat_col] = X_encoded[cat_col].apply(lambda x: known_mapping.get(x, 0))
    return X_encoded


label_encoder = pd.unique(X_train[cat_col].astype(str))
X_train[cat_col] = safe_encode(X_train, label_encoder)[cat_col]
X_test[cat_col] = safe_encode(X_test, label_encoder)[cat_col]

# Split data for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Convert to LightGBM format
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Model parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Prepare submission
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df[target_col] = test_preds
submission_df[id_col] = test_df[id_col]

submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
